description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on resident care and facility success. The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader committed to maintaining high standards of quality and compliance.

As the LNHA, you will oversee all aspects of facility management, including clinical services, financial performance, and staff development. You will ensure the delivery of exceptional patient care while fostering a positive and supportive environment for both residents and employees. This is a full-time opportunity with a competitive salary package.

Join a team dedicated to excellence and continuous improvement. We are looking for a leader who can inspire staff, optimize operational efficiency, and uphold the facility's reputation for outstanding care. If you are a results-oriented LNHA with a passion for geriatric care, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current and valid Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage operations, finances, and staff effectively
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and compassionate Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) for a PRN, per-visit role in Helena, AL. This is an excellent opportunity to provide essential therapy services within a home health setting, offering flexibility and a competitive per-visit rate.

As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist to implement individualized treatment plans, helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life. Your role will involve assisting patients with therapeutic exercises, activities of daily living, and adaptive equipment training in their homes.

This position offers a unique chance to make a significant impact on patients' lives while managing your own schedule. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about patient care and thrives in an autonomous environment.
requirements: Valid Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) license in Alabama
Previous experience in a home health or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to travel to patient homes within the Helena, AL area
